subject: Restart daemon to activate /harness/overhead endpoint
description: The daemon needs a restart to pick up two code changes merged to main: (1) lib/human-input.js now exports harnessOverheadTokens(); (2) daemon.js has a new GET /harness/overhead route. Run: cd /Users/imyu/Desktop/zonoid && node daemon.js (or however the daemon is normally restarted — check package.json scripts or the existing restart pattern). Verify the endpoint responds: curl http://localhost:8787/harness/overhead
